source_text: III. et sic raptus est athleta Christi a ministris diaboli, gratias agens deo et patri per Iesum Christum filium eius, qui eum dignum iudicavit certando diabolum superare; ductusque foras muros lapidibus caesus reddidit spiritum. Passus est autem famulus dei Maximus apud Asiam provinciam, secundo idus Maii, sub Decio imperatore et Optimo proconsule, regnante domino nostro Iesu Christo; cui est gloria in saecula saeculorum, amen.
thought_title: Led out and stoned to death
orientation: After Optimus condemns him for refusing to offer sacrifice to Diana, the narrator reports how Maximus is seized, led out, and killed.
pass_a_gloss: And in this way the champion for Christ was seized by the devil's agents, while giving thanks to God and Father through Jesus Christ his son, who judged him worthy by contending to overcome the devil; and having been led outside the walls, having been struck with stones, he gave up his spirit. But the servant of God Maximus suffered in the province Asia on the second day before the Ides of May, under Decius as emperor and Optimus as proconsul, with our Lord Jesus Christ reigning; to whom is glory into ages of ages, amen.

pass_b_english: And so the champion for Christ was seized by the devil's agents, while giving thanks to God and Father through Jesus Christ, his Son, who judged him worthy to overcome the devil by contending. He was led outside the walls and struck with stones, and he gave up his spirit.

The servant of God Maximus suffered in the province of Asia on the second day before the Ides of May, under Emperor Decius and the proconsul Optimus, while our Lord Jesus Christ reigns, to whom is glory forever and ever, amen.
